qa.title: Q2535 (Nov. 6, 2026)
qa.question: I have this follower on my field. If I play a Heartless Battle, transforming 2 Puppets in my EX area into a Lloyd token and a Victoria token, does this follower's automatic ability trigger?
qa.answer:
Yes, it does.

Transforming cards means banishing them and creating the same number of specified tokens in their place. Since the 2 Puppets would leave your EX area when banished, this follower's automatic ability would trigger, putting 2 Fairy tokens into your EX area.

qa.title: Q2575 (Nov. 6, 2026)
qa.question: If my opponent only has a Heavenly Aegis, which has Aura and "can't be destroyed by abilities," on their field, can this follower's Last Words ability cause them to bury it?
qa.answer: Yes. Aura prevents the card from being selected by enemy abilities, but in this case Heavenly Aegis isn't being selected by an ability. Also, burying a card isn't the same as destroying it.
